response.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(s.mean_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.mean_usage - o.mean_usage) AS average_above_overall FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE s.mean_usage > o.mean_usage;
